description: Layouts adapted from a running Flint2 installation. No messages, credentials, site lookups or inputs are included. Configure your GELF input ID when installing; review the new stream before use. Maps and intelligence widgets require optional enrichment. See the repository guide.

description.@value: Backend-only dashboard projection; leaves ECS fields intact.

source.@value:
rule "Flint2 portable megabytes"
when
    to_string($message.event_module) == "flint2" && (to_string($message.event_dataset) == "flint2.network_flow" && has_field("source_bytes"))
then
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_megabytes", to_double($message.source_bytes) / 1000000.0);
end

description.@value: Backend-only dashboard projection; leaves ECS fields intact.

source.@value:
rule "Flint2 portable peer inbound"
when
    to_string($message.event_module) == "flint2" && (to_string($message.event_dataset) == "flint2.network_flow" && to_string($message.network_direction) == "inbound" && has_field("source_ip"))
then
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_peer_ip", $message.source_ip);
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_wan_ip", $message.destination_ip);
end

then
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_peer_ip", $message.destination_ip);
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_wan_ip", $message.source_ip);
end

source.@value:
rule "Flint2 portable private destination"
when
    to_string($message.event_module) == "flint2" && (to_string($message.event_dataset) == "flint2.router_log" && has_field("destination_ip") && (cidr_match("10.0.0.0/8", to_ip($message.destination_ip)) || cidr_match("172.16.0.0/12", to_ip($message.destination_ip)) || cidr_match("192.168.0.0/16", to_ip($message.destination_ip))))
then
    set_field("flint2_dashboard_destination_class", "private_ipv4");
end
